# WINKO 3D vendor modules

These browser modules are vendored for the static WINKO site so the real WebGL scene can run without a package build step.

- Three.js 0.160.0 (`three.module.js`, `OrbitControls.js`)
- GSAP 3.12.5 (`gsap.module.js`, `gsap-core.js`, `CSSPlugin.js`)
- GSAP ScrollTrigger 3.12.5 (`ScrollTrigger.module.js`, `Observer.js`)

The upstream licenses and notices are preserved in the downloaded source files.
